pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 겸 (To Do X and Also Y / Dual Purpose)
meaningEn: Expressing dual purpose or intention ('to do X and also Y / concurrently').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan maksud atau tujuan ganda ('sekalian untuk X dan juga Y').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 겸 / Consonant stem -> ~을 겸. Often repeated: V1~(으)ㄹ 겸 V2~(으)ㄹ 겸.
notesEn.usage: Used when an action is taken to accomplish two aims at the same time.
notesEn.nuance: Implies killing two birds with one stone.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 겸 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 겸. Sering diulang: V1~(으)ㄹ 겸 V2~(으)ㄹ 겸.
notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika suatu tindakan dilakukan untuk mencapai dua tujuan secara bersamaan.
notesId.nuance: Menyiratkan menyelam sambil minum air (sekali dayung dua tiga pulau terlampaui).

examples.hangul: 산책도 할 겸 장도 볼 겸 나갔다 왔어요.
examples.romaja: san-chaek-do hal gyeom jang-do bol gyeom na-gat-da wat-seo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: I went out to take a walk and also do some grocery shopping.
examples.meaningId: Saya keluar sekalian untuk jalan-jalan dan juga belanja bulanan.

examples.hangul: 기분 전환도 할 겸 여행을 떠났어요.
examples.romaja: gi-bun jeon-hwan-do hal gyeom yeo-haeng-eul tteo-nat-seo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: I went on a trip to refresh my mind (and for other reasons).
examples.meaningId: Saya pergi berlibur sekalian untuk menyegarkan pikiran.

examples.hangul: 한국어 공부도 할 겸 한국 드라마를 봐요.
examples.romaja: han-gug-eo gong-bu-do hal gyeom han-guk deu-ra-ma-reul bwa-yo.
examples.meaningEn: I watch Korean dramas to study Korean as well.
examples.meaningId: Saya menonton drama Korea sekalian untuk belajar bahasa Korea.

quiz.question: Which connector indicates doing an action for two concurrent purposes?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 겸 is used to state dual intentions or multi-purpose actions.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 겸 digunakan untuk menyatakan niat ganda atau tindakan bertujuan ganda.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I went out to take a walk and also do grocery shopping. -> 산책도 할 ___ 장도 볼 겸 나갔다 왔어요.
fillInTheBlank.sentenceHangul: 산책도 할 ___ 장도 볼 겸 나갔다 왔어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert bound noun expressing dual purpose.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat yang mengekspresikan tujuan ganda.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I went out to take a walk and also do grocery shopping.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya keluar sekalian untuk jalan-jalan dan juga belanja.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 산책도 할 겸 장도 볼 겸 나갔다 왔어요
constructionQuiz.answerReading: san-chaek-do hal gyeom jang-do bol gyeom na-gat-da wat-seo-yo
acceptableVariants: 산책도 할 겸 장도 볼 겸 나갔다 왔습니다
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use walk also (산책도) + dual purpose (할 겸) + groceries also (장도) + dual purpose (볼 겸) + went out and came back (나갔다 왔어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan jalan-jalan juga (산책도) + tujuan ganda (할 겸) + belanja juga (장도) + tujuan ganda (볼 겸) + keluar lalu pulang (나갔다 왔어요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~기 짝이 없다 (Incomparably / Incredibly - Extreme Degree)
meaningEn: Expressing an unmatched or extreme level of an emotion or state ('incredibly / beyond measure').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan tingkat emosi atau kondisi yang tidak ada tandingannya/sangat ekstrem ('sangat luar biasa / tak tertandingi').

notesEn.usage: Used with descriptive verbs to express an extreme state or feeling.
notesEn.nuance: 짝 means 'pair/match'. Literally means 'there is no match for this degree'.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja/Sifat + ~기 짝이 없다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan dengan kata kerja deskriptif untuk mengekspresikan kondisi atau perasaan yang sangat ekstrem.
notesId.nuance: 짝 berarti 'pasangan/tandingan'. Secara harfiah berarti 'tidak ada tandingannya untuk tingkat ini'.

examples.hangul: 시험 결과가 안 좋아서 안타깝기 짝이 없어요.
examples.romaja: si-heom gyeol-gwa-ga an jo-a-seo an-ta-kkap-gi jjak-i eobs-eo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Because the test result was bad, I feel incredibly regretful.
examples.meaningId: Karena hasil ujiannya buruk, saya merasa sangat amat menyesal.

examples.meaningEn: I am matchlessly grateful for your help.
examples.meaningId: Saya sangat amat berterima kasih atas bantuan Anda.

quiz.question: What is the literal background of '~기 짝이 없다'?
options: There is no match/pair for this extreme degree
There is no reason to do it
quiz.explanationEn: 짝 means match/pair; ~기 짝이 없다 means something is unmatched in its intensity.
quiz.explanationId: 짝 berarti tandingan/pasangan; ~기 짝이 없다 berarti sesuatu tidak ada tandingannya dalam hal intensitas.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: His behavior was beyond rude. -> 그의 행동은 무례하기 ___ 없었습니다.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert bound noun 'match/pair' with subject particle.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat 'tandingan/pasangan' dengan partikel subjek.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'His behavior was beyond rude.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Tindakannya sungguh sangat tidak sopan.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use his behavior (그의 행동은) + rude (무례하기) + matchless (짝이 없었습니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan tindakannya (그의 행동은) + tidak sopan (무례하기) + tiada tandingan (짝이 없었습니다).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~아/어 마지않다 (From the Bottom of My Heart / Never Cease To)
meaningEn: Expressing deep, heartfelt continuous feeling or action ('do without stopping / sincerely').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan perasaan atau tindakan yang sangat mendalam dan tulus dari lubuk hati ('tidak hentinya / dari lubuk hati').

notesEn.usage: High literary, formal expression used almost exclusively with emotional/relational verbs like 축하하다 (congratulate), 감사하다 (thank), 기대하다 (anticipate).
notesEn.nuance: Carries high reverence and formal elegance.

notesId.usage: Ekspresi formal/sastra tingkat tinggi yang hampir secara eksklusif digunakan dengan kata kerja emosional/relasional seperti 축하하다 (mengaruniakan selamat), 감사하다 (berterima kasih), 기대하다 (menantikan).
notesId.nuance: Memiliki rasa hormat yang tinggi dan keanggunan formal.

examples.meaningEn: I congratulate you on passing from the bottom of my heart.
examples.meaningId: Saya mengucapkan selamat atas kelulusan Anda dari lubuk hati yang paling dalam.

examples.meaningEn: I never cease to be grateful for your grace, teacher.
examples.meaningId: Saya tak henti-hentinya berterima kasih atas kebaikan Anda, Guru.

examples.meaningEn: I sincerely anticipate glory in your future.
examples.meaningId: Saya sungguh menantikan kemuliaan pada masa depan Anda.

quiz.question: Which verb pattern conveys 'heartfelt, unceasing congratulation/gratitude' in formal speeches?
quiz.explanationEn: ~아/어 마지않다 expresses heartfelt, unceasing feelings in high formal settings.
quiz.explanationId: ~아/어 마지않다 mengekspresikan perasaan tulus yang tak henti-hentinya dalam situasi formal tinggi.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I congratulate you on passing from the bottom of my heart. -> 합격을 진심으로 축하해 ___.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan akhiran perasaan tak henti-henti formal.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean (formal high): 'I congratulate you on passing from the bottom of my heart.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea (formal tingkat tinggi): 'Saya mengucapkan selamat atas kelulusan Anda dari lubuk hati yang paling dalam.'
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan kelulusan (합격을) + dengan tulus (진심으로) + mengucapkan selamat (축하해) + tak henti-hentinya (마지않습니다).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~을/ㄹ 리 만무하다 (No Possibility Whatsoever / Highly Improbable)
meaningEn: Expressing that there is zero logic or possibility for a scenario ('absolutely no way').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan bahwa sama sekali tidak ada logika atau kemungkinan untuk suatu skenario ('sama sekali tidak mungkin').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 리 만무하다 / Consonant stem -> ~을 리 만무하다.
notesEn.usage: An advanced, emphatic form of ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다.
notesEn.nuance: 만무 (萬無) literally means 'ten thousand lacks/nothings'—meaning 100% absence of possibility.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 리 만무하다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 리 만무하다.
notesId.usage: Bentuk penegas tingkat lanjut dari ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다.
notesId.nuance: 만무 (萬無) secara harfiah berarti 'sepuluh ribu ketiadaan'—yang berarti 100% tidak ada kemungkinan.

examples.hangul: 그 사람이 제안을 받아들일 리 만무합니다.
examples.romaja: geu sa-ram-i je-an-eul ba-da-deu-ril ri man-mu-ham-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: There is absolutely no way that person will accept the proposal.
examples.meaningId: Sama sekali tidak ada kemungkinan orang itu akan menerima usulan tersebut.

examples.hangul: 이 시간에 가게가 문을 열었을 리 만무해요.
examples.romaja: i si-gan-e ga-ge-ga mun-eul yeol-eoss-eul ri man-mu-hae-yo.
examples.meaningEn: There is zero chance the store is open at this hour.
examples.meaningId: Sama sekali tidak mungkin toko buka pada jam segini.

examples.meaningEn: There is no way anyone would be fooled by such a lie.
examples.meaningId: Tentu saja sama sekali tidak mungkin ada yang tertipu oleh kebohongan seperti itu.

quiz.question: What does '만무하다' mean in '~ㄹ 리 만무하다'?
quiz.explanationEn: 만무하다 reinforces ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 by declaring absolute zero chance.
quiz.explanationId: 만무하다 memperkuat ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 dengan menyatakan nol kemungkinan mutlak.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: There is zero chance the store is open at this hour. -> 이 시간에 가게가 문을 열었을 리 ___.
fillInTheBlank.sentenceHangul: 이 시간에 가게가 문을 열었을 리 ___.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert advanced adjective meaning 'has zero possibility'.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata sifat tingkat lanjut yang berarti 'sama sekali tidak ada kemungkinan'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'There is zero chance the store is open at this hour.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Sama sekali tidak mungkin toko buka pada jam segini.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 이 시간에 가게가 문을 열었을 리 만무해요
constructionQuiz.answerReading: i si-gan-e ga-ge-ga mun-eul yeol-eoss-eul ri man-mu-hae-yo
acceptableVariants: 이 시간에 가게가 문을 열었을 리 만무합니다
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use at this hour (이 시간에) + store (가게가) + opened door past modifier (문을 열었을) + zero possibility (리 만무해요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan pada jam segini (이 시간에) + toko (가게가) + penjelas buka pintu lampau (문을 열었을) + sama sekali tak mungkin (리 만무해요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 vs ~(으)ㄹ 지경이다 (Extreme State Comparison)
meaningEn: Expressing being on the verge of a physical/mental state ('on the point of / about to').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan berada di ambang suatu kondisi fisik/mental ('sampai-sampai mau / hampir / serasa mau').

notesEn.usage: Hyperbolically describes extreme fatigue, pain, sadness, or stress.
notesEn.nuance: 지경 means 'boundary/situation'. Literally 'arrived at the edge/verge of X'.

notesId.usage: Secara hiperbolis menggambarkan kelelahan, rasa sakit, kesedihan, atau stres yang sangat ekstrem.
notesId.nuance: 지경 berarti 'batasan/situasi'. Secara harfiah 'tiba di ambang/tepi X'.

examples.meaningEn: It is so exhausting that I am on the verge of collapsing.
examples.meaningId: Sangat lelah sampai-sampai rasanya mau pingsan/roboh.

examples.meaningEn: I am so hungry I feel on the verge of dying.
examples.meaningId: Saya sangat lapar sampai rasanya mau mati.

examples.meaningEn: It's so frustrating that I am about to go crazy.
examples.meaningId: Sangat frustrasi sampai rasanya mau gila.

quiz.question: What does '~지경이다' describe?
options: Being on the verge/edge of a physical or mental state
Granting an exception to a rule
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 지경이다 expresses being hyper-climaxed at the brink/verge of a state.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 지경이다 mengekspresikan kondisi yang berada di batas ambang/puncak suatu situasi.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: It's so frustrating that I am about to go crazy. -> 답답해서 미칠 ___이에요.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat yang berarti 'ambang/batasan'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'It is so exhausting that I am on the verge of collapsing.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Sangat lelah sampai-sampai rasanya mau pingsan.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use too hard (너무 힘들어) + collapse modifier (쓰러질) + verge of (지경이에요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan sangat lelah (너무 힘들어) + penjelas pingsan (쓰러질) + ambang (지경이에요).
